name: usage-trace
description: Trace keyword usage, call chains, and database tables in Java/Spring, Python, or C# with an offline HTML report, plus a field-regression pipeline (business scenarios, API test cases, seed SQL release files). Auto-trigger for prompts like 分析当前项目的 orderId, 查找字段使用情况, 追踪调用链, 字段流向, 生成字段用例, 字段回归, 打通上线SQL.

interface.shortDescription: Trace field usage / call chains / DB tables + field regression pipeline. Triggers: 分析当前项目的 orderId, 查找字段使用情况, 生成字段用例, 字段回归, 打通上线SQL.
interface.longDescription: Install once via marketplace plugin. When the user says things like 分析当前项目的 orderId or Trace storeNo usage, load the skill, ensure the usage-trace CLI is available (pip install from GitHub if needed), and generate a single offline HTML report with usage sites, call chain, and database tables. For field-regression prompts like 给 storeNo 生成回归用例 or 打通上线SQL, the field-regression skill turns the chain JSON into business scenarios, API test cases, idempotent seed SQL release files, and triggers the apifox skill for automated regression. 支持中文：分析当前项目、查找字段使用情况、追踪调用链、字段流向分析、生成字段用例、字段回归、打通上线SQL。
